title: 第2477章 老夫秦九宫第2476章 剑破山河
slug: 重生本统子教宿主当老六
content_zh:
在东境联盟的大军和赤盟的大军激战的同时，在东境南部正有一高一矮两道黑色身影在快速向西飞去。
这两人不是旁人，正是陆沉的分身陆鸣和叶玲玲，他们并没有前往战场，而是朝着元流门的山门所在地飞了过去。
他们前段时间都在东边那片被发狂妖兽占据的区域救治幸存者，如今来这边也是陆沉的意思。
而陆沉让他们来元流门的地盘可不是为了提前摘桃子，而是想趁着元流门防御空虚的时候彻底断了宋焱的退路。
而且，他也想看看这元流门背地里到底有没有能“量产”八境强者的手段，若是有的话必须将其连根拔起才行。
在抵达元流门所处的山脉上空后，陆鸣和叶玲玲并没有第一时间就冲杀进去，而是先打量起了眼前的元流门。
元流门之前算是个半隐世的宗门，虽然东境的很多人都知道这个宗门的存在，但直到这次东境大乱它才算真正活跃在了世人面前。
在此之前，没人知道元流门的底蕴有多深，甚至到现在绝大多数的外人也不知道元流门到底有多少底蕴。
放眼望去，只见元流门被一座巨大的护宗大阵笼罩着，大阵里面足足笼罩了十几座山峰，这便是元流门的核心领地了。
虽然这次东境联盟可谓是倾巢而出，但宋焱总归是偏向自己人的，元流门内目测还有数千名低阶修士留守。
在打量了一圈眼前的情况后，叶玲玲收回视线看向陆鸣：“大哥，我们还是直接动手吧！
这里面的那些家伙都是些五境以下的小喽啰，只要我们能打破这层乌龟壳，我的小虫子们就能把他们吃的连渣都不剩。”
叶玲玲的性格极其的爱憎分明，对于无冤无仇的人，她素来都愿意释放善意，哪怕是遇到素不相识的陌生人，她也愿意出手给对方疗伤。
而对于自己和陆沉的仇人，她素来都是无所不用其极的，只要是她能想到的手段，她用起来都不会有任何心理负担。
听到叶玲玲的提议，陆鸣却摇头示意她不要着急，既然宋焱留下了这么多人，肯定不会只留了这么一群小喽啰。
此刻的元流门内肯定还有强者坐镇，要是贸然动手没能一击打开这座护宗大阵，等到里面的强者被惊动可就麻烦了。
好在陆沉此前在潜龙学府的时候跟着李书亦学了不少有关阵法的知识，陆鸣多少也能看出些阵法的门道。
如果是想依靠阵纹来破掉眼前的护宗大阵，对陆鸣来说不仅费时费力，而且还未必能在不惊动里面的人的情况下成功。
而陆鸣和本体陆沉一样，他要的只是找到这座大阵最薄弱的位置，然后依靠庚金白虎印强行将其打破就够了。
在仔细打量了一番后，陆鸣很快就找到了这座大阵的弱点，然后直接带着叶玲玲飞了过去。

让人没想到的是，宋焱本就知道自家的护宗大阵哪里薄弱，所以在几个薄弱的位置都安排了弟子看守。
因此，陆鸣两人刚刚来到那处薄弱位置，就被值守在这里的两名年轻弟子给发现了。
那两人在看到有两个黑袍人靠近后，第一时间就摆出了警惕的架势，其中一人更是直接拿出了传讯玉牌。
不等他把消息传出去，就见陆鸣取出了荡武并激活了庚金白虎印，然后毫不犹豫地挥刀劈在了眼前的护宗大阵上。
伴随着一道清脆的响声响起，眼前这座看似坚不可摧的护宗大阵就这样被劈开了一道缺口。
在那道缺口出现的瞬间，陆鸣和叶玲玲嗖的一声直接闯了进去，趁着那两人震惊的时候直接将他们斩杀在了当场。
叶玲玲深吸了一口气，随即对着陆鸣笑道：“嘿嘿，大哥你先歇着，接下来就看我的吧！”
说罢，她抬起两只纤纤玉手，海量的黑色蛊虫当即从她的衣袖中涌了出来，然后迅速向着元流门的每一个角落蔓延开来。
那些蛊虫很快就铺满了大半个元流门，等元流门的弟子们反应过来的时候已经连逃跑的机会都没有了。
听着那些人的惨叫，陆鸣和叶玲玲心中没有丝毫的同情，他们对于这个草菅人命的宗门没有丝毫好感，也并不觉得这里面会有无辜的人。
就在元流门的众人死伤惨重时，一道紫色光柱忽然从元流门深处的后山里冲天而起，一股强大的神识瞬间就席卷了整个元流门。
感应到这股神识的探查，陆鸣下意识地握紧了手中的长刀，同时习惯性地将叶玲玲护在了身后。
虽然叶玲玲已经不是当初那个弱小的小丫头了，不过她还是喜欢这种被自家大哥护在身后的感觉。
在被陆鸣护在身后后，叶玲玲的指间迅速亮出几根飞针，在用元力包裹住这些飞针的同时，她也激活了庚金白虎印。
几个呼吸后，那股神识的主人已经锁定了陆鸣两人的位置，随即直接化作一道紫色流光冲到了他们面前。
随着光芒散去，一名身穿紫色锦袍的老者稳稳地停在了陆鸣两人的面前：“两个小贼，安敢闯我元流门？”
陆鸣看不穿对方的修为，但能感觉到对方的修为大概在八境九重后期到八境十重初期之间，显然也不是个好对付的货色。
在看清了对方的样貌后，陆鸣的嘴角不由得勾起了一抹冷笑：“老家伙，你在元流门里的地位应该不低吧？就是不知道你耐不耐杀了。”
闻言，那老者顿时暴怒不已：“老夫秦九宫，乃是元流门的太上长老，就凭你一个八境七重的小辈也想杀老夫？”
此话一出，陆鸣的眼中顿时露出了一抹惊喜之色：“太上长老？那可太好了，我这就让你瞧瞧我到底能不能杀了你。”

说罢，他脚下猛地一踏，在冲向对方的瞬间就已经在身上凝聚起了雷帝铠，龙象之力也被他给激活了。
在冲向对方的同时他也没忘了叶玲玲：“小矮子，这老家伙交给我来解决，其他人就交给你了，记住要一个不留！”
闻言，叶玲玲的嘴角当即勾起一抹笑意：“大哥放心，我保证，今天这元流门连一只苍蝇都飞不出去！”
content_en:
While the armies of the Eastern Alliance and the Red Alliance were fighting fiercely, two black figures, one tall and one short, were flying west quickly in the southern part of the Eastern Alliance.
These two people were none other than Lu Chen's clones, Lu Ming and Ye Lingling. They did not go to the battlefield, but flew towards the mountain gate of Yuanliu Gate.
Some time ago, they were treating survivors in the area occupied by crazy monsters to the east, and now it was Lu Chen's intention to come here.
And Lu Chen asked them to come to Yuanliumen's territory not to pick peaches in advance, but to completely cut off Song Yan's retreat while Yuanliumen's defenses were empty.
Moreover, he also wanted to see if there was any means behind the Yuanliu Sect that could "mass-produce" eight-level warriors. If so, it would have to be uprooted.
After arriving at the mountain range where the Yuanliu Gate was located, Lu Ming and Ye Lingling did not rush in immediately, but first looked at the Yuanliu Gate in front of them.
The Yuanliu Sect was considered a semi-hidden sect before. Although many people in the Eastern Territory were aware of the existence of this sect, it was not until the Great Chaos in the Eastern Territory that it became truly active in front of the world.
Before this, no one knew how deep the Yuanliu Sect was. Even now, most outsiders don't know how deep the Yuanliu Sect is.
Looking around, I saw that Yuanliumen was shrouded by a huge sect-protecting formation, which covered more than a dozen mountain peaks. This was the core territory of Yuanliumen.
Although the Eastern Territory Alliance came out in full force this time, Song Yan always favored his own people. It was visually estimated that there were thousands of low-level monks left behind in the Yuanliu Sect.
After taking stock of the situation in front of her, Ye Lingling withdrew her gaze and looked at Lu Ming: "Brother, let's just take action!
Those guys here are all little minions below the fifth level. As long as we can break this turtle shell, my little bugs can eat them up to nothing. "
Ye Lingling's character is extremely clear between love and hate. She has always been willing to show kindness to people who have no grievances or enmities. Even if she meets a stranger she has never met, she is willing to heal the other person's wounds.
As for her and Lu Chen's enemies, she has always used all possible means. As long as it is a method she can think of, she will not have any psychological burden when using it.
Hearing Ye Lingling's suggestion, Lu Ming shook his head and told her not to worry. Since Song Yan left so many people behind, he definitely wouldn't just leave such a group of minions behind.
There must be strong men in the Yuanliu Sect at this moment. If he rashly attacks and fails to open the sect-protecting formation with one blow, he will be in trouble when the strong men inside are alerted.
Fortunately, Lu Chen had learned a lot about formations from Li Shuyi when he was at Qianlong Academy, and Lu Ming was able to see some of the ways of formations.
If he wanted to rely on formation patterns to break the sect-protecting formation in front of him, it would not only be time-consuming and labor-intensive for Lu Ming, but he might not be able to succeed without alerting the people inside.
And Lu Ming, just like the original Lu Chen, all he wanted was to find the weakest point in the formation, and then rely on the Geng Jin White Tiger Seal to forcefully break it.
After looking carefully, Lu Ming quickly found the weakness of the formation, and then flew over directly with Ye Lingling.
What people didn't expect was that Song Yan knew where his sect-protecting formation was weak, so he arranged for disciples to guard several weak positions.
Therefore, as soon as Lu Ming and his two men arrived at that weak spot, they were discovered by the two young disciples on duty here.
When the two people saw two men in black robes approaching, they immediately put on a vigilant posture, and one of them even took out the jade communication card.
Before he could spread the news, Lu Ming saw Lu Ming take out the Dangwu and activate the Geng Jin White Tiger Seal, and then without hesitation slashed at the sect-protecting formation in front of him with his sword.
With a crisp sound, the seemingly indestructible shield in front of meIn this way, a gap was opened in the Zongda Formation.
The moment the gap appeared, Lu Ming and Ye Lingling rushed in with a whoosh, and killed the two people on the spot while they were shocked.
Ye Lingling took a deep breath, then smiled at Lu Ming and said, "Hey, brother, please rest first, and then you can watch me!"
After saying that, she raised her two slender hands, and a large number of black Gu worms immediately poured out of her sleeves, and then quickly spread to every corner of the Yuanliu Sect.
Those Gu insects quickly covered most of Yuanliu Sect, and by the time the disciples of Yuanliu Sect reacted, they had no chance to escape.
Listening to the screams of those people, Lu Ming and Ye Lingling didn't feel the slightest sympathy in their hearts. They had no good impressions of this sect that looked down upon human life, and they didn't think there were innocent people among them.
Just when everyone in the Yuanliu Sect suffered heavy casualties, a purple beam of light suddenly rose into the sky from the back mountain deep inside the Yuanliu Sect, and a powerful spiritual consciousness swept through the entire Yuanliu Sect in an instant.
Sensing the detection of this spiritual consciousness, Lu Ming subconsciously clenched the long knife in his hand, and at the same time habitually protected Ye Lingling behind him.
Although Ye Lingling is no longer the weak little girl she used to be, she still likes the feeling of being protected by her big brother.
After being protected by Lu Ming, Ye Lingling quickly flashed several flying needles between her fingers. While wrapping these flying needles with Yuanli, she also activated the Gengjin White Tiger Seal.
After a few breaths, the owner of that spiritual consciousness had locked the position of Lu Ming and the two of them, and then turned into a purple stream of light and rushed in front of them.
As the light dissipated, an old man wearing a purple brocade robe stopped steadily in front of Lu Ming and the two of them: "You two little thieves, how dare you break into my Yuanliu Gate?"
Lu Ming couldn't see through the opponent's cultivation level, but he could feel that the opponent's cultivation level was between the late eighth level and ninth level to the early eighth level and tenth level. Obviously, he was not an easy person to deal with.
After seeing the other party's appearance clearly, Lu Ming couldn't help but sneer at the corner of his mouth: "Old guy, your status in the Yuanliu Sect should not be low, right? I just don't know if you can't bear to be killed."
Hearing this, the old man suddenly became furious: "I, Qin Jiugong, am the Supreme Elder of the Yuanliu Sect. You, a junior at the seventh level of the eighth realm, want to kill me?"
As soon as these words came out, a look of surprise suddenly appeared in Lu Ming's eyes: "Supreme Elder? That's great. I'll let you see if I can kill you."
After that, he stepped down hard, and the moment he rushed towards the opponent, he had already condensed the Thunder Emperor Armor on his body, and the power of the Dragon Elephant was also activated by him.
While rushing towards the other party, he did not forget Ye Lingling: "Little dwarf, leave this old guy to me, and leave the others to you. Remember to leave no one behind!"
Hearing this, a smile immediately appeared on Ye Lingling's lips: "Don't worry, brother, I guarantee that not even a fly will fly out of Yuanliu Sect today!"
